items.title: Bitcoin, copper, stocks, yields all fall; gold rises
EBA designates Circle’s USDC as the EU’s first ‘significant’ e-money token
items.summary: The EBA classified Circle’s USDC as the EU’s first "significant" e-money token, with new supervisory responsibilities beginning Nov.

items.title: Lido Adds Direct ETH Staking From Four Layer 2s to Its Interface
items.summary: Users receive wstETH from local liquidity pools, while ETH is bridged to Ethereum for staking and the pools are replenished in the background.

items.title: White House crypto council chief Patrick Witt steps down
items.summary: Witt’s departure leaves a leadership gap at the White House Crypto Council and marks the fourth high-profile exit from the advisory group.
